NewsArticle.Title: Religious Mass Update
NewsArticle.Content: On 99.12.17, religious Mass temporarily requires a prayer necklace to be worn in order to worship. This update is necessary, which I discovered on 99.12.16. I apologize for the sudden alteration. It is necessary. As of 99.12.18, prayer necklace is not needed to be worn for religious Mass. See your priest to join a religion. Afterward, also see your priest to politely request an additional prayer necklace if you no longer have your original necklace.
